scripts.build: node -e "const v=process.env.npm_package_version||'dev';require('fs').writeFileSync('src/version.ts','export const VERSION = \"'+v+'\";\n')" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c)"
